decisions.reason: Product A builds directly on the firm's programming and data-analysis knowledge, and its continued own-page presence signals that the firm can interpret results and improve it, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
Product C's energy-tariff domain is farther from the firm's core programming/consultancy knowledge, and its demotion to a mere mention suggests weak assimilation and learning, making drop likely.
Product E's regional area definition tool is closely related to the firm's location-based capabilities and likely supports core products, so the firm has sufficient absorptive capacity to keep it.
